independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Logs contain user essay, teacher guide, stage=lookup, duration=12ms and trace T8. Select allowed fields.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Keep stage, duration and trace; exclude essay and teacher content. Authorisation to process data does not imply permission to retain it in logs.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
A trace ID can still be linkable; minimisation and role-controlled access remain necessary.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: For this policy log trace ID, stage, status, duration and error category; do not log passcodes, student text or teacher answers. Restrict access and declare retention.
